prompt: Audit the ltv_disco contract at /Users/EBmic/membrane-core/contracts/ltv_disco/ for security vulnerabilities. This contract manages LTV-backed deposits with multiple asset queues, unstaking requests, revenue claiming, manager fees, bad debt tracking, and affiliate sharing. Focus on bad debt handling, access control, refund logic, and state management. Produce a structured security report.

assertions.name: has-structured-report
assertions.description: Output follows a structured report format with headers, severity levels, and locations

assertions.name: has-severity-classifications
assertions.description: Each finding has a severity level (Critical/Major/Minor/Informational)

assertions.name: has-code-locations
assertions.description: Findings reference specific file paths and line numbers or function names

assertions.name: has-executive-summary
assertions.description: Report includes a summary overview of total findings by severity

assertions.name: checks-bad-debt-tracking
assertions.description: Analyzes AddBadDebt function and how bad debt state is persisted and managed

assertions.name: reviews-revenue-distribution
assertions.description: Checks revenue claim logic for correctness and potential exploitation

assertions.name: checks-unstake-logic
assertions.description: Reviews the request/complete/cancel unstake flow for timing attacks or state issues

assertions.name: reviews-manager-fee-access
assertions.description: Checks who can set/modify/clean manager fees and affiliate configurations
